primers.name: P3_RT_PBS_Rev
primers.selfDetail: 3′ 6-mer is reverse-complementary to positions 1–6, enclosing a 3 nt loop — close enough to the 3′ end to compete with priming
primers.purpose: Long Ultramer. 5′ tail (5′→3′): [TTTT clamp]+[RC(BsmBI site)]+[N]+[RC(OH3)]+[RC(PolyT)]+[RC(PBS)]+[RC(RT)]. 3′ annealing end: RC(scaffold last 15 nt) anneals to Step-1 amplicon. The RE tail at 5′ is essential — it creates the 3′ sticky end (OH3) after BsmBI digestion of the Step-2 PCR product, enabling directional Golden Gate ligation. Order HPLC-purified Ultramer.
warnings: High self-complementarity risk — 3′ 6-mer is reverse-complementary to positions 1–6, enclosing a 3 nt loop — close enough to the 3′ end to compete with priming
GC 73% is above 70% — risk of secondary structure and non-specific priming

P3 3′ scaffold overlap: ⚠ P3 3' scaffold region folds back on itself: 6 bp stem (5 G:C), 3 nt loop, est. ΔG -12.5 kcal/mol on the increment approximation. This may reduce P3 priming efficiency in Step 2 PCR. Consider extending the scaffold overlap from 15 to 20 nt (use M3_SCAFFOLD.slice(-20)) or perform Step 2 PCR with a 95°C initial denaturation and reduce ramp rate. Fixed for every design: the 15 nt of scaffold P3 anneals through is the same in every pegRNA cassette, so this is a property of the route, not of this target.

primers.name: P4_RT_PBS_Fwd_overlap
primers.purpose: ⚠ NOT for BsaI/BsmBI Golden Gate cloning — P4 has no RE recognition site or vector arm and cannot produce a directly cloneable GG product. Use ONLY in a 3-fragment Gibson or In-Fusion assembly where the RT+PBS region is added as a separate fragment. For standard Golden Gate (BsaI/BsmBI) cloning, use P1+P3 (mega-primer overlap extension). Anneals to scaffold last 15nt, extends into RT region.

primers.name: P5_Verify_Fwd
primers.purpose: Unique site in pYPQ141D-peg, upstream of the cloning site. Empty vector gives 941 bp; a correct clone gives 1070 bp. Read off the deposited sequence.

primers.name: P6_Verify_Rev
primers.purpose: Unique site in pYPQ141D-peg, downstream of the cassette. Already reverse-complemented, so use as written. Expected bands: 941 bp empty, 1070 bp filled.
